### How to Use the Gift of Prophecy
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-apr-11-2011.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:1
Points:
- Prophecy is a spiritual gift Christians are urged to prioritize and earnestly desire.
- Prophesying primarily involves proclaiming God's truth rather than predicting future events.
- The gift takes biblical truth and applies it directly to present-day life.
- Prophetic proclamation is not restricted to ordained clergy, as all believers are ministers.
- Believers gifted with prophecy should make sharing God's Word a daily focus.

### Embrace the Gift of Prophecy
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/embrace-the-gift-of-prophecy.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:1
Points:
- Scripture calls Christians to pursue love and eagerly desire prophecy above other spiritual gifts.
- Exercising prophetic words can bring timely encouragement and clarity to individuals seeking God's will.
- Operating in this gift fosters deeper intimacy with the Holy Spirit.
- Delivering words from God carries a solemn responsibility to speak faithfully and obediently.
- Churches should equip believers to tune their hearts to the Spirit's voice to build up others.

### Communication
Author: One Year Devotions for Men
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/communication-one-year-devotions-for-men-may-10.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 14:6
Points:
- Although communication channels change across eras, fundamental principles of communication remain constant.
- Paul challenged speech that cannot be understood because it fails to benefit the listener.
- Spiritual speech in worship must prioritize intelligibility so that hearers, especially seekers, are helped.
- Effective transmission of truth demands both clear enunciation and perceptive listening.
- The contemporary church must communicate the timeless gospel in language everyday people comprehend.
